keyFindings.description: Architect's condition 3 (focusMark lands whether or not the diagram has drawn) is met for the #b- block link and VersionView only. The live document's comment/ask link (/issues/<KEY>/spec?comment=<id>) focuses its quote once (useMarginSheet.ts:577, guarded by focusedRouteMark) and nothing re-runs it after a late diagram draws. Reviewer scratch row (R8's held worker and document, live document, chromium, never committed): anchoring off, quote y=657 before the draw and y=10668 after, toBeInViewport 'viewport ratio 0'; anchoring on, quote held at y=657. The PR's own R7/R8 hold the page to the anchoring-off case. The fix belongs where both route-driven and card-driven focus calls go (ProofDocument's bridge, ProofDocument.tsx:439-442) or in the route effect, plus a row on the live document.

An editor request the renderer never answers (requestMermaidDrawing returns noop while failed, :364; fail() clears waiting draws, :226) leaves the view's previous diagram in place above the edited source, with no status (mermaid-code-block-view.ts:163-169 never reaches show). A worker restart after a 5 s refusal or a cancelled in-flight draw that fails to load (a tab left open across a redeploy) gets there. Condition 4 says the block shows its source with no worker, and the view's doc (:33-34), MermaidDrawer's doc (mermaid-svg.ts:52-53) and proof-editor/AGENTS.md say the same; R9 covers only a worker that never started. Found by the thermonuclear deep review (Minor there); raised because a drawing that does not match its source hides the renderer failure.
